Thanks — reviewed the COI quickly. Policy limits look fine (General Liability 1M/2M). Two items to request from the broker:

1) Endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured (CG 20 10 or similar) — we require the certificate to indicate the endorsement has been issued or provide the endorsement PDF.
2) Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood on the General Liability and Employers Liability sections (or an explicit statement on the endorsement).

If AstraLogic can get both items on the revised COI, procurement can mark the insurance requirement satisfied and we can move forward with PO issuance. If they cannot get an Additional Insured endorsement, we can consider a conditional PO for one month and revisit.

I also confirmed that the W-9 is valid and the TAX ID matches the onboarding form.

Karthik — once we receive the endorsed COI, can you confirm the PO creation cadence and whether we need a signed vendor agreement attached to the PO? I recall for services under $100k the standard T&C acceptance in the onboarding form is sufficient.

Jordan, Tessa, Mina — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the PO process from Finance:

- Once procurement marks insurance as satisfied (i.e., we have the endorsed COI and W-9 on file), Finance will generate PO-8421 in our ERP. Expect a PDF PO and an email with payment terms (Net 45 by default unless otherwise negotiated).
- We do not require a separate signed master services agreement for this engagement if the vendor onboarding form includes the standard Redwood T&Cs and the anticipated annual spend is under $100k. If AstraLogic expects more, we will loop Legal.
- Please include invoice instructions in the onboarding form (billing email and remit address). If vendor prefers ACH, we will send a DocuSign ACH form after PO issuance (security review required).

Jordan — action items for you:
